briefdescription.para: JUCE-backed TCP server that accepts Interprocess client connections.

detaileddescription.para: nexus::Daemon wraps juce::InterprocessConnectionServer to listen on a TCP port, write the bound port to AppModel (which persists it to ~/.config/end/nexus/<uuid>.nexus), and create a nexus::Channel for each accepted client.

Daemon also owns the broadcast and per-session subscriber registries that were previously held inline in Nexus. Session callback wiring (onBytes and State ValueTree exit detection) is applied via wireSessionCallbacks() after each terminal::Session is created by Nexus in daemon mode. State updates (cwd, foregroundProcess) are broadcast via valueTreePropertyChanged.

Daemon registers itself as a juce::ValueTree::Listener on each session's State ValueTree to detect shellExited without crossing component callback boundaries. Exit cleanup is deferred via juce::MessageManager::callAsync.
Static platform helpers (hideDockIcon, spawnDaemon) are declared here so callers need only one include. Implementations live in Daemon.mm (macOS / Linux) and DaemonWindows.cpp (Windows).
